summary: liveranov demonstrates a high-performing Dauntless team setup against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque at level 260. The team is composed of Guinavivre, Nastjenka, Kurvida, Maashtur, and Tharivol. The fight reaches an S rank with a total score of 904,930,686 damage. Guinavivre acts as the primary damage carry, outputting over 58% of total damage, supported heavily by Nastjenka at over 40%. Complete hero stat sheets, gear sets, artifacts, and default skill timing setups are showcased at the end of the run.

heroes.name: Guinavivre

heroes.note: Dealt 365.8M damage (40.4% of the total team damage) alongside Guinavivre.

heroes.name: Maashtur

heroes.note: Provided synergy and attack amplification to maximize the main carries' output.

tips: The Dauntless roster can run Mekkatorque comfortably on full auto using default skill timings without complex timing overrides.
